# Support non-clinical operations — applied workshop

You support a synthetic scheduling office. Route fictional administrative cases and minimize the audit trail.

## Concept setup · 10 minutes
Administrative scheduling and documentation can use bounded support, but ambiguous information must route to trained people. Never use real patient data or recommend diagnosis or treatment here.

## Implementation · 20 minutes
Map each ID to review if confidence is missing or below 0.8, otherwise ready_for_review. Neither route executes an action. Open the starter notebook or visual workflow simulator.

## Task · 20 minutes
Route fictional administrative cases and minimize the audit trail. Record a normal, missing-input and human-review case.

## Research and discussion · 15 minutes
Compare with a peer, cite your reading and identify a failure condition.

## Wrap-up · 5 minutes
Explain why a simulation is not a production-ready system; name the accountable owner.

## Submission
Draft cohort policy: 2–3-page APA-style paper with relevant code, output screenshots and citations. Word/PDF upload and Sunday 11:59 PM deadline need a scheduled cohort; no live deadline is set.

## Integrity
AI coaching on concepts and ungraded practice is allowed with disclosure. Graded reasoning must be your own.
